provenance.application: Rust esp-hal tier-1 application with raw-register peripheral checks
provenance.note: The pinned supplier builds the Rust application with the Espressif Rust toolchain and espflash save-image --merge. This lane admits the retained bytes; it does not rebuild the fixture or establish an ESP-IDF C application build.

provenance.application: Retained hosted Arduino ESP32-S3 smoke artifact
provenance.note: The supplier manifest describes a hosted Arduino sketch printing SMOKE_OK, but retains neither its exact sketch source nor a compiler/core lock. The separate source-debug/main.ino belongs to a different binary and is not this artifact's source.

firmware.consoleEvidence: The retained image's SMOKE_OK bytes are observed on UART0; a USB-only selection leaves them in the engine's unheard UART stream. Do not infer the output channel from the supplier's CDC build prose.
